Other functional checks used separate workspaces during portions of the serial and concurrent trials.

An unrelated workspace ws_CDIJzOag-rmezMPiwiYUnSi9hfa2gsHK started a full build near the end of the concurrent trial and overlapped the full-plus-small trial. Its two latest jobs were terminal when inspected after this suite.
A positive default cap of five was committed to main during these tests but was not deployed to the live service. All these measurements used the previous uncapped service.
The monitor samples aggregate service memory and PSI, including retained idle JVMs and unrelated workspaces.
The first small F-to-G patch request lacked the final newline and was rejected without applying. The corrected patch succeeded and matched the expected full source before submission.
Some compiler logs were truncated by the MCP response. Their retained terminal summaries include exact fresh remote action counts and successful build outcomes.
